## Problem and change

Describe the behavior this fixes or the user workflow this enables.

## Reproduction / validation

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q`
- [ ] Changes to retrieval/generation include measured evaluation and failure cases, or state why not applicable
- [ ] Citations retain source identity and no safety guardrails are weakened

## Evidence and limitations

State corpus version/hash, model(s), benchmark fixture and hardware if reporting performance or accuracy. Distinguish structural source-label checks from independent factual support review.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No private documents, customer information, secrets or sensitive prompts are committed
- [ ] Any new ingestion, networking, or retention behavior is documented and tested

## Related issue

Link an issue where appropriate.
